  "id": "REG-DL-1",

  "alternative": "Leave the source and spec unchanged and retain all 16 lint failures until a separate scoped refactor adds DBC contracts and module Entity Inventory entries.",
  "verify": "Re-run npx --no-install gennady lint --spec=specs/settings/registry/registry.spec.md src/flag-registry.ts and confirm only the exempted dbc and inventory diagnostics remain.",
  "lintExemption": {
    "file": "src/flag-registry.ts",
    "checks": ["dbc", "inventory"]
  }
}
EOF
cat .claude/tmp/lint-proposal.json
ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls node_modules | head -50; echo '---'; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat gennady.yaml
